summary: Alkermes plc filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Authorized Generic Product Supply Agreement with Amneal Pharmaceuticals, which had granted rights to distribute an authorized generic version of VIVITROL. The termination followed Amneal's notice that it did not wish to order batches after failing to meet certain terms. No penalties were incurred, and all claims were released. This is a routine contractual termination without special-situation implications such as M&A or restructuring; there are no deal terms or strategic actions beyond the end of a supply agreement.
